title: Your account. From start to sign in.
disclosure: Illustrated walkthrough based on this project's web flow. Example data only; this is not a live account recording. The activation deposit is a sandbox simulation, not a real payment.

scenes.title:
Your account.
From start
to sign in.
scenes.description: A clear, step-by-step guide to opening your Alister Bank web account.
steps: Apply with your details
Complete identity verification
Set up your account and sign in
scenes.transcript: Welcome to the Alister Bank web account guide. Follow the application, email verification, video KYC, sandbox activation, account setup, and first sign-in. These are illustrative screens with example data, not a live account recording.

scenes.title:
A little preparation.
A smoother start.
scenes.description: Have your information ready before opening the application.
steps: Keep your email inbox and mobile number handy
Prepare the identity documents for your country
Use a device with a camera and good lighting
scenes.note: India access is invitation-only in this project.
scenes.transcript: Keep your email inbox, mobile number, identity documents, and signature ready. You will also need a camera for video KYC. This project's India services are limited to pre-approved participants. On the homepage, select Request Account Access to open the application.

scenes.title:
Start with
your details.
scenes.description: Choose your country, then enter your details exactly as they appear on your government ID.
steps: Enter your name, email and mobile number
Add your date of birth and gender
Choose Savings, Current or Business Elite
scenes.note: Your country determines the documents required.
scenes.transcript: Select your country. Enter your first and last name, email, mobile number, date of birth, and gender as required by the form. Choose Savings, Current, or Business Elite. Complete any other relevant fields, then select Next Step. Your country determines the document requirements.

scenes.title:
Opening for
your business?
scenes.description: Business Elite adds a Company Info step after your personal information.
steps: Enter your company name and entity type
Complete the required registration details
Upload the business documents requested
scenes.note: Savings and Current applicants skip this step.
scenes.transcript: If you selected Business Elite, complete the additional Company Info step. Provide your company name, entity type, registration details, and the business documents marked as required. The account will be held in the company name. Savings and Current applicants skip this step.

scenes.title:
Add the place
you call home.
scenes.description: Enter your residential address carefully before continuing.
steps: Add your address line and city
Select or enter your state or province
Enter the PIN code or postal code
scenes.note: For India, the PIN code must contain six digits.
scenes.transcript: Enter your residential address, city, state or province, and PIN or postal code. Address line two is optional. Indian PIN codes must contain six digits. Check that your address is accurate, then continue to Documents.

scenes.title:
Your documents.
Clear and complete.
scenes.description: Upload the documents shown for your selected country. Make every detail readable.
steps: India: provide PAN and Aadhaar details and files
Upload your live selfie and signature
For other countries, follow the required list
scenes.note: PAN verification can update and lock your legal name.
scenes.transcript: Document requirements depend on your country. For India, provide PAN and Aadhaar numbers and uploads, a live selfie, and your signature. Passport and address proof are optional for India. Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh have different identity-document requirements and require address proof. Successful PAN verification can update and lock your legal name. Upload clear supported images or PDFs.

scenes.title:
Check your inbox.
Verify it is you.
scenes.description: Request the six-digit verification code using the email shown on screen.
steps: Select Send OTP and open your email
Enter your own six-digit code
Verify the code before continuing
scenes.note: Wrong email? Use Change and request a new code.
scenes.transcript: Check the displayed email address, then select Send OTP. Open your inbox and enter the six-digit code you received. Verify the code before moving forward. If the email address is wrong, use Change and request a new code. Never share your OTP with anyone.

scenes.title:
One final check.
Then submit.
scenes.description: Review your information, uploaded documents and the terms before sending your application.
steps: Check every section for accuracy
Go back to correct anything that is wrong
Submit and keep your customer ID
scenes.note: Submission is not the same as an active account.
scenes.transcript: Review your personal details, company details if applicable, address, and KYC documents. Read the terms and privacy information. Go back to correct any mistakes, then submit the application. Keep the customer ID shown in the confirmation. Your account still needs the remaining verification and activation steps.

scenes.title:
Your next step
arrives by email.
scenes.description: Look for the video KYC invitation in your registered inbox.
steps: Check your inbox and spam folder
Open the secure video KYC link
Read the consent screen and allow the camera
scenes.note: Expired link? Contact support for a fresh one.
scenes.transcript: After submission, look for the video KYC invitation sent to your registered email address. Delivery and review can take time, so check your spam folder too. Open the secure link in a supported browser, read the consent screen, and allow camera access. Contact support if your link has expired.

scenes.title:
Face the camera.
Follow the prompts.
scenes.description: Sit in good light and keep your face clearly visible inside the guide.
steps: Position your face in the on-screen circle
Follow the head-movement and blink prompts
Review your selfie and retake if needed
scenes.note: The movement prompts can vary each session.
scenes.transcript: Position your face inside the circle in good lighting. Follow the on-screen movement prompts, which can vary between sessions, and blink when asked. Keep still while the selfie is captured automatically. Review the captured selfie and retake it if the image is not clear.

scenes.title:
Scan your ID.
Check the details.
scenes.description: Keep the document fully visible, in focus and free from glare.
steps: Capture your ID using the on-screen guide
Review and correct the extracted details
Submit your video KYC for processing
scenes.note: A completed capture does not guarantee approval.
scenes.transcript: Capture your identity document using the on-screen guide. Keep every edge visible and avoid glare. Review the extracted name, date of birth, and ID number, correcting any reading errors. Submit the verification. A successful capture is not a guarantee of approval; wait for the next email.

scenes.title:
Complete the
activation step.
scenes.description: After KYC processing, open the activation-deposit link sent by email.
steps: Check the account and minimum amount shown
Use only an admin-approved sandbox test card
Wait for confirmation and the setup email
scenes.note: Simulation only. Do not enter a real payment card.
scenes.transcript: After KYC processing, open the activation-deposit link in your email. Check the account and minimum amount shown. This project's deposit is a sandbox simulation, not a real payment. Use only an admin-approved sandbox test card, never a real payment card. After confirmation, wait for the separate account-setup email.

scenes.title:
Make your
account yours.
scenes.description: Open the account-setup link from your email and create your login credentials.
steps: Choose a username of at least five characters
Create and confirm a password of at least eight
Set a four-digit security PIN, then activate
scenes.note: Keep your password and transfer PIN private.
scenes.transcript: Open the account-setup link from your email. Choose a username with at least five characters. Create a unique password with at least eight characters and confirm it. Set a four-digit security PIN used to authorize transfers. Select Activate My Account, then Login Now. Keep your password and PIN private.

scenes.title:
Your first login.
You are almost in.
scenes.description: On the login screen, use the Password tab to enter your new credentials.
steps: Enter your username or registered email
Enter your password and the shown CAPTCHA
Select Sign In to open your dashboard
scenes.note: Forgot your password? Use the reset link on this page.
scenes.transcript: On the login page, choose the Password tab. Enter your username or registered email and your new password. Type the characters shown in your own CAPTCHA; refresh it if it is hard to read. Select Sign In. If your credentials are accepted, you will reach the dashboard. Use Forgot password if you need to reset your password.

scenes.title:
Signed in.
Ready for
your next step.
scenes.description: Your dashboard brings your account overview and banking tools together.
steps: Review your account details
Explore transactions and account tools
Sign out when using a shared device
scenes.note: Never share your OTP, password or security PIN.
scenes.transcript: After a successful login, review your account details and explore the dashboard's account tools. Keep your OTP, password, and security PIN private, and sign out on shared devices. You can replay any chapter in this guide whenever you need a reminder.
